title: 第19章 被侮辱了第20章 取名鬼才
slug: 灵气复苏我有个吞噬系统
content_zh:
丘凌风和肖严两人对立。
其他人都是自觉的散开，给两人留足了动手的场地。
“给我乖乖挨揍吧！”
肖严冷笑一声，而后朝着丘凌风冲去，同时一拳抡出。
肖严很显然没有学习过任何的武技。
他的动作在丘凌风看来，漏洞百出。
估计肖严之前的战斗也完全是靠境界碾压。
毕竟一条主经脉就是两百斤的力量加持。
丘凌风很轻松的闪开了肖严的拳头，同时一脚横踢，击中了肖严的腹部。
后者猝不及防，直接倒飞了出去。
一脸痛苦的捂着肚子，跪在地上站不起来了。
“就这？”
一众学生心中不约而同的蹦出了这个念头。
就连丘凌风也是一脸莫名其妙。
他原本以为肖严就算不是他的对手，但是也需要耗费很大力气解决。
毕竟两人修为相同。
但他万万没想到，他就是一脚的功夫，直接让肖严跪在地上起不来了。
这……赢得也太轻松了吧？
“风声大雨点小，你之前说的那么牛逼，还以为你多厉害呢。”
丘凌风无语的说道。

就连八位金澜城过来的弟子也是一脸懵逼。
就一脚功夫，同为通脉境四段武者的肖严，被丘凌风解决了？
他们能够很清楚的看出来，肖严这块璞玉……璞过头了啊！
连打架都不会打，狠话就放出一大堆了。
啧……
啊，这。
期间的落差太大，差点没把叶小小的腰给闪断。
“你们南斗书院还要这个肖严不？不要的话我太玄剑院一并收了咯？”
紫晓灵笑眯眯的问道。
“收！就算没打赢又怎么样，反正他没正式的修炼过，以后的进步空间还是很大的。”
叶小小嘴硬地说道。
在这之后，紫晓灵就激动的跑到了丘凌风身边，道：
“没想到你还挺厉害的吗，竟然一脚解决了那个家伙。”
“别说了，我感觉我被侮辱了。”
丘凌风一捂脸，无语的说道。
没打之前他还以为肖严多厉害呢。
毕竟光听名字就知道这家伙不一般。
这名字说出去就挺唬人的。
content_en:
Qiu Lingfeng and Xiao Yan are in opposition.
The others dispersed voluntarily, leaving plenty of space for the two of them to take action.
"Just give me a good beating!"
Xiao Yan sneered, then rushed towards Qiu Lingfeng and punched out at the same time.
Xiao Yan obviously has not learned any martial arts.
In Qiu Lingfeng's opinion, his actions were full of loopholes.
It is estimated that Xiao Yan's previous battles were all based on realm crushing.
After all, one main meridian is blessed with two hundred kilograms of power.
Qiu Lingfeng easily dodged Xiao Yan's fist and at the same time kicked Xiao Yan in the abdomen.
The latter was caught off guard and flew backwards.
He clutched his stomach with a painful look on his face and knelt on the ground unable to stand up.
"That's it?"
This thought popped up in the minds of all the students.
Even Qiu Lingfeng looked confused.
He originally thought that even if Xiao Yan was not his opponent, it would still take a lot of effort to solve it.
After all, the two of them have the same cultivation level.
But he never expected that with just one kick, Xiao Yan could not get up from his knees on the ground.
Isn't this... winning too easy?
"The wind is loud and the rain is small. You said you were so awesome before. I thought you were so awesome."
Qiu Lingfeng said speechlessly.
Even the eight disciples who came from Jinlan City looked confused.
With just one kick, Xiao Yan, who was also a fourth-level martial artist in the Tongmai Realm, was defeated by Qiu Lingfeng?
They could clearly see that Xiao Yan's piece of raw jade... was too raw!
He doesn't even know how to fight, so he just lets out a lot of harsh words.
Tsk…
Ah, this.
The gap during this period was so great that Ye Xiaoxiao's waist was almost broken.
"Does Nandou Academy still want Xiao Yan? If not, Taixuan Sword Academy will take it in as well?"
Zi Xiaoling asked with a smile.
"Stop it! So what if he doesn't win the fight? Anyway, he has never practiced formally. There is still a lot of room for improvement in the future."
Ye Xiaoxiao said stiffly.
After that, Zi Xiaoling ran to Qiu Lingfeng excitedly and said:
"I didn't expect you to be quite powerful. You actually killed that guy with one kick."
"Stop talking, I feel insulted."
Qiu Lingfeng covered his face and said speechlessly.
Before the fight, he thought Xiao Yan was really powerful.
After all, just by hearing the name, you know that this guy is special.
This name is quite deceiving.
